title: Canonical valid Read Holding Registers
purpose: Construct a canonical valid MODBUS/TCP request for function 0x03 with conservative starting address and register quantity.
expected_behavior: Server should parse a valid MBAP header and function 0x03 request for starting address 0x0000 and quantity 0x0002, then return register data or a standard exception.
constraints_preserved: MBAP header included before the PDU.
length is 0x0006, which matches unit_id plus 5-byte function 0x03 PDU.
Function code 0x03 is used for Read Holding Registers.
Request fields are starting address followed by quantity of registers, both big-endian 16-bit.
issue_safety_notes: No issue-specific content is used. This is a conservative baseline seed suitable for safe initial mutation.
